hook: Your landing on Titan in 2005 showed a riverbed.
title: Huygens landed on Titan and found a riverbed
description:
In 2005 the Huygens probe parachuted onto Saturn's moon Titan and photographed the surface. The pictures showed rounded pebbles and channels that look like a dry riverbed. Titan has lakes of liquid methane.

Series: If You Were in Space.
comment_prompt: Would you visit Titan? Yes or no
